text:
The provided evidence is an abstract of a review article that outlines the strengths and limitations of conventional strategies and novel methods (such as microfluidics) for EV isolation, summarizes commercially available kits/techniques, and assesses market demand. 

In contrast, the candidate hypothesis describes a highly specific experimental platform: a dual-functional biosensor utilizing a thermosensitive, pH-responsive hydrogel (P(NIPAM-co-BMA-co-NHSMA)) functionalized with CD63 aptamers and coupled with SERS/fluorescence. The abstract does not develop, test, or support this specific biosensor system as its hypothesis.

VERDICT: REJECT
